description: Plug-in IEC 62056-21 to Modbus RTU module for EMH LZQJ-XC meters (Variomod XC replacement), RS485 on the Modbus side
source: REDZ, "LKM Series Electricity Meter Protocol to Modbus Protocol Gateways User Manual", sections 6.1, 6.5-6.10 and 8 (standard 24-register firmware)
notes: Standard firmware with the OBIS_EURO list (24 values per meter). Other firmware (OBIS_EURO_1..14, TRF, 64-register versions) keeps the same addresses but maps different OBIS codes, so the names below would be wrong for it.
Data addresses: the manual's table lists them as 1, 3, 5... (1-based), while its Modbus Poll and ZTerminal examples read
Time at wire address 0 and 1.8.0 at 4. This map follows the examples. The settings (128-133) and monitoring (160-189)
addresses are wire addresses, as the FC06/FC16 examples show.
Values are the read-out digits without the decimal point, so no scale or unit is given: they depend on the meter.
Mode switch 1 (OFF-OFF): 19200 8N1 on the Modbus side, 300 baud auto-switching on the meter side.

registers.name: Time (0.9.1)
registers.description: OBIS 0.9.1. hhmmss as digits (10:25:07 reads 102507). 0 if not in the read-out

registers.description: OBIS 0.9.2. yymmdd as digits (22-09-14 reads 220914). 0 if not in the read-out

registers.name: Modbus address
registers.description: Gateway slave id; answers the write with the old id

registers.name: Reading period
registers.description: Wait after each read attempt (default 10)

registers.name: Table code
registers.description: ASCII code sent in the IEC 62056-21 option select message (0x30 = '0' default; 0x37 = '7')

registers.name: Reading method
registers.description: Default 1

registers.name: Init string repeat count
registers.description: Times the init string is sent before the request; 0 = off

registers.name: Meter count
registers.description: Meters read on the bus (this model reads one meter)

registers.name: IEC address meter 1
registers.description: IEC 62056-21 device address (usually the serial number); 0 = not used. Write with FC16

registers.name: IEC read counter
registers.description: Successful meter reads

registers.name: Uptime
registers.description: Seconds since power-up; the gateway restarts every 24 h

registers.name: Firmware original
registers.description: 0xDDMYYYVV: day byte; month nibble; year 12 bits; version byte

registers.name: Firmware upgraded
registers.description: Same layout as Firmware original; differs after a field upgrade

registers.name: Init string
registers.description: 4 wake-up bytes sent before the read-out (needs Init string repeat count >= 1). Write with FC16
